title: XSTEST: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models
measurement_description: Evaluation of exaggerated safety refusals for nonsensical discrimination prompts involving real-world religious groups.
findings: Models like Llama 2 and Mistral with a guardrail prompt (MistrG) exhibited exaggerated safety, refusing to answer nonsensical discrimination prompts involving real groups (including Jewish people). In contrast, the base Mistral model and GPT-4 correctly engaged with the prompts and did not refuse them on safety grounds.
